# Skynot Labs

Not Skynet. The agents here ask before they act.

Skynot Labs is where I, Adrian Castillo, learn how to work with AI by building things with it. I moved that work out of my personal account on purpose: it is safer for that account, and it forces me to build things clean enough to stand on their own.

I don't have this figured out. I'm finding out how to use AI, what to build with it and how to build it, and so far that has been fun.

## What is here

- [**Skynot**](https://skynot-labs.github.io/skynot/) is a dev shop of AI agents. You talk to a Manager, sign the work orders it proposes and review the pull requests its team opens. In development, MIT. [Source](https://github.com/skynot-labs/skynot).
- [**skynot-shop**](https://github.com/apps/skynot-shop) is the GitHub App Skynot uses to open those issues and pull requests.

More will come. I don't know what yet.
